messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> LATENCY_P99_BURN for inference-gateway-prod. p99 latency = 1.35s over the last 5m (threshold 0.8s). Alert rule: latency.p99.endpoint > 0.8s for 5m. Pager: eng-oncall.
alex: acked. I'm on it. pinging infra and runtime.
pagerduty-bot: Alert acknowledged by alex (on-call). Escalation halted.
sam: rolling deploy to inference-gateway completed ~10m before this alert (deploy id: deploy-2026-03-14-0320). seeing increased tail latency in traces referencing kv-cache miss spikes.
maria: interesting — KV cache eviction rate jumped in memstats around the deploy. could be new model variant increasing memory footprint. can someone query memstat/heap for replicas?
jamie: looking at autoscaler metrics now. there are repeated scale-ups to 16 -> 2 -> 16 (flapping) over last 6m. requests queued length spiked during scale-downs. autoscaler cooldown might be too aggressive for this workload.
kai: also seeing elongated kernel queue times on GPU nodes (gpumem pressure). some instances hit soft OOM and the runtime is dropping batching to preserve stability.
alex: immediate plan: 1) pause recent deploy (rollback routing) 2) pin traffic to last known-good model variant (quantized-1.2) 3) increase min replicas temporarily to avoid flapping. anyone can run the route change? I'll run redwoodctl.
sam: running route change now. command:
```
# pin traffic to quantized-1.2
redwoodctl routes set inference-gateway-prod --model quantized-1.2 --weight 100
```
sam: applied. traffic should start draining away from new variant. giving it 30s to observe.
maria: bumping min replicas for pool inference-pool-prod to 8 to prevent scale-down churn.
jamie: increased minReplicas=8 via k8s patch. autoscaler will respect in ~15s.
pagerduty-bot: Note: page suppressed for duplicate alerts for 10m per suppression rule autopager/noise-reduce.
alex: customer-impact quick note: interactive completions for web UI saw higher latency (a small subset): ~2.1% of requests >2s; core API throughput not affected. no major error spikes, just higher tail latency and more user-perceived slowness on realtime endpoints.
kai: looking into runtime logs: KV cache miss storms correlated with requests that hit large context sizes (>= 16k). a combination of new tokenization + model variant increased KV pressure.
maria: recommend: 1) keep pinned model 2) revert tokenization tweak from deploy-2026-03-14-0320 (sam can help revert) 3) roll a tuned quantized variant after perf tests.
sam: tokenization tweak revert queued; will patch configmap and restart inference replicas in a controlled rolling fashion.
jamie: monitoring p99 now. Grafana dashboard link: https://grafana.company/reports/infra/inference/p99?from=2736051000&to=2736051600
alex: p99 dropped to 0.48s within ~2m of the routing change, but still above target. continuing to watch.
kai: gpumem pressure easing, cache eviction rate dropping — good signal. partial recovery in kernel queue times.
pagerduty-bot: Alert update: LATENCY_P99_BURN state -> acknowledged by alex. Suppression still active.
alex: handing off to jamie for the night-shift follow-through. jamie, I'll leave open tasks: watch for p99 < 0.35s sustained for 20m, confirm deploy rollback config committed, and follow up with runtime team to produce a perf-safe model variant.
jamie: taking over. timeline + notes recorded in incident doc: https://wiki.company/incidents/2736051200. I'll post an incident summary once stable. +1 if you want me to notify customers in channel #support-prod.
maria: +1 for customer note. ops: add a postmortem checklist item: improve autoscaler cooldown tuning for inference pool and add a pre-deploy perf gate for KV pressure.
alex: thanks all. I'll ping folks if anything else immediate. Incident remains open until p99 < 0.35s for 20m.
incident-bot: Alert resolved: LATENCY_P99_BURN returned to normal at 2736051480. Auto-notification will send closure in 15m if no regressions.
